title: CQRS Query Specification Schema
description: Schema for individual CQRS Query (Read surface) definition files in queries/*.query.yaml.

id.description: Unique dotted identifier of the query (e.g. faktury.stats.get).

name.description: Short human-readable title of this query.

description.description: Detailed explanation of what state is inspected.

ui_trigger.description: Which UI component, button or user action executes this query.

response_schema.description: Expected shape and types of the response data.
